BCUT2D_CHGHI: Highest burden eigenvalue of charge-weighted adjacency matrix.
BCUT2D_CHGLO: Lowest burden eigenvalue of charge-weighted adjacency matrix.
BCUT2D_LOGPHI: Highest burden eigenvalue of LogP-weighted adjacency matrix.
BCUT2D_LOGPLOW: Lowest burden eigenvalue of LogP-weighted adjacency matrix.
BCUT2D_MRHI: Highest burden eigenvalue of molar refractivity-weighted adjacency matrix.
BCUT2D_MRLOW: Lowest burden eigenvalue of molar refractivity-weighted adjacency matrix.
BCUT2D_MWHI: Highest burden eigenvalue of molecular weight-weighted adjacency matrix.
BCUT2D_MWLOW: Lowest burden eigenvalue of molecular weight-weighted adjacency matrix.
BalabanJ: Balaban J topological index; measures graph complexity and branching.
BertzCT: Topological complexity measure based on graph distance and connectivity.
ExactMolWt: Exact molecular weight calculated from isotopic masses.
FpDensityMorgan1: Density of Morgan fingerprint bits at radius 1.
FpDensityMorgan2: Density of Morgan fingerprint bits at radius 2.
FpDensityMorgan3: Density of Morgan fingerprint bits at radius 3.
FractionCSP3: Fraction of sp3-hybridized carbons relative to total carbons.
HallKierAlpha: Hall-Kier alpha descriptor; measures molecular flexibility.
HeavyAtomCount: Number of non-hydrogen atoms in the molecule.
HeavyAtomMolWt: Molecular weight calculated excluding hydrogen atoms.
Ipc: Information content of the molecular graph.
Kappa1: First Kappa shape descriptor; relates to molecular branching.
Kappa2: Second Kappa shape descriptor; relates to molecular shape complexity.
Kappa3: Third Kappa shape descriptor; relates to overall molecular shape.
LabuteASA: Labute accessibile surface area; hydrophobic descriptor.
MaxAbsEStateIndex: Maximum absolute value of electrotopological state indices.
MaxEStateIndex: Maximum electrotopological state index; highest electronegativity-weighted state.
MaxPartialCharge: Maximum absolute partial charge on any atom.
MinAbsEStateIndex: Minimum absolute value of electrotopological state indices.
MinEStateIndex: Minimum electrotopological state index; lowest electronegativity-weighted state.
MinPartialCharge: Minimum partial charge on any atom.
MolLogP: Wildman-Crippen LogP; computed partition coefficient for lipophilicity.
NHOHCount: Count of N-H and O-H groups (hydrogen bond donors and hydroxyl groups).
NOCount: Count of N and O atoms (heteroatoms that contribute to polarity).
NumAliphaticCarbocycles: Number of aliphatic (non-aromatic) rings with only carbon atoms.
NumAliphaticHeterocycles: Number of aliphatic rings containing at least one heteroatom.
NumAliphaticRings: Count of non-aromatic rings in the molecule.
NumAromaticCarbocycles: Number of aromatic rings containing only carbon atoms.
NumAromaticHeterocycles: Number of aromatic rings containing at least one heteroatom.
NumAromaticRings: Count of aromatic rings in the molecule.
NumHAcceptors: Count of hydrogen bond acceptor atoms.
NumHDonors: Count of hydrogen bond donor atoms.
NumRadicalElectrons: Count of unpaired electrons (radical sites) in the molecule.
NumRotatableBonds: Count of rotatable bonds; indicates molecular flexibility.
NumSaturatedCarbocycles: Number of saturated carbocycles without aromatic character.
NumSaturatedHeterocycles: Number of saturated heterocycles without aromatic character.
NumSaturatedRings: Count of saturated rings with no double bonds.
NumValenceElectrons: Total number of valence electrons in the molecule.
PEOE_VSA1: Partial charge-weighted surface area bin 1 (most negative).
PEOE_VSA14: Partial charge-weighted surface area bin 14 (most positive).
RingCount: Total number of rings in the molecular structure.
SMR_VSA1: Van der Waals surface area bin 1 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA10: Van der Waals surface area bin 10 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA2: Van der Waals surface area bin 2 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA3: Van der Waals surface area bin 3 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA4: Van der Waals surface area bin 4 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA5: Van der Waals surface area bin 5 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA6: Van der Waals surface area bin 6 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA7: Van der Waals surface area bin 7 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA8: Van der Waals surface area bin 8 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SMR_VSA9: Van der Waals surface area bin 9 (Molar refractivity scaled).
SlogP_VSA1: Van der Waals surface area bin 1 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA10: Van der Waals surface area bin 10 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA11: Van der Waals surface area bin 11 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA12: Van der Waals surface area bin 12 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA2: Van der Waals surface area bin 2 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA3: Van der Waals surface area bin 3 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA4: Van der Waals surface area bin 4 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA5: Van der Waals surface area bin 5 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA6: Van der Waals surface area bin 6 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA7: Van der Waals surface area bin 7 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA8: Van der Waals surface area bin 8 (LogP scaled).
SlogP_VSA9: Van der Waals surface area bin 9 (LogP scaled).
TPSA: Topological Polar Surface Area; sum of surface areas of polar atoms.
fr_Al_COO: Count of aliphatic carboxylic acid groups.
fr_Al_OH_noTert: Count of aliphatic primary and secondary hydroxyl groups (excluding tertiary).
fr_Ar_COO: Count of aromatic carboxylic acid groups.
fr_Ar_N: Count of aromatic nitrogen atoms in heterocycles.
fr_COO: Count of carboxylate groups (ionized carboxylic acids).
fr_COO2: Count of carboxylic acids and carboxylate groups.
fr_C_O_noCOO: Count of C-O bonds not in carboxylic acids or carboxylates.
fr_HOCCN: Count of heterocycles with oxygen, carbon, and nitrogen.
fr_NH0: Count of tertiary amines (N with no hydrogens).
fr_NH1: Count of secondary amines (N with one hydrogen).
fr_NH2: Count of primary amines (N with two hydrogens).
fr_Ndealkylation1: Count of N-dealkylation sites of type 1.
fr_Ndealkylation2: Count of N-dealkylation sites of type 2.
fr_Nhpyrrole: Count of N-H groups in pyrrole-like rings.
fr_alkyl_halide: Count of alkyl halide (C-X where X is halogen) groups.
fr_halogen: Count of halogen atoms (F, Cl, Br, I).
fr_nitro_arom_nonortho: Count of aromatic nitro groups not in ortho position.
fr_oxazole: Count of oxazole rings (5-membered rings with O and N).
fr_phenol_noOrthoHbond: Count of phenols without ortho hydrogen bonding capability.
fr_unbrch_alkane: Count of unbranched alkane chains of length 4 or more.
qed: Quantitative estimate of drug-likeness; composite pharmaceutical property measure.
